cards.title: Create a Project
cards.code:
npm create astro@latest
cd my-astro-site
npm run dev

cards.title: Astro Component
cards.description: The component script runs on the server; the template produces HTML.

cards.title: Dynamic Static Paths
Client Island
cards.description: Hydrate only interactive components and choose when their JavaScript loads.

cards.title: Server Island
cards.description: Render personalized or dynamic content separately without delaying the main page.

cards.title: Environment Variables
cards.code:
const publicValue = import.meta.env.PUBLIC_API_URL;
const secret = import.meta.env.API_SECRET;
cards.description: Only variables prefixed with PUBLIC_ are available to client code.

cards.title: Choose Rendering Intentionally
cards.code:
static output  -> content known at build time
server output  -> request-time rendering
client island  -> browser interactivity
server island  -> deferred personalization
cards.description: Do not hydrate a component just because it was written with a UI framework.
